title: From Experiments to Decisions: Reusing Evidence in Autonomous Coding Research
abstract: arXiv:2609.13299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous coding agents can remember an experiment yet carry forward a conclusion it does not justify. We reconstruct how evidence is reused in a 400-task NeuroGolf campaign, with selected wellbore-prediction records from the same operator as cross-domain comparisons. A numerical counterexample exposes an overbroad exclusion; other episodes distinguish what failed, incomplete and revised programs justify doing next. The wellbore records reveal an additional weakness: a coordinator correctly acknowledges a novelty-only rejection, then summarizes it as measured closure. Separately, a prefix-based acceptance gate at three thresholds yields worse target scores than ungated adaptation in the retained experiment. These cases motivate an inspectable handoff linking the tested proposition, its scope, candidate and evaluator identity, check statuses, and reopening condition. A dispatch tree separates investigation, repair, reopening and stopping

translated_title: 从实验到决策：自主编码研究中的证据复用
translated_abstract: 自主编码智能体能够记住一个实验，却可能延续该实验并不能证明的结论。我们重构了在一个400任务的NeuroGolf活动中证据是如何被复用的，并以同一运营商选择的部分井眼预测记录作为跨领域对比。一个数值反例揭示了一次过于宽泛的排除；其他案例则区分了失败的、不完整的和已修订的程序各自能够证明下一步该做什么。井眼记录揭示了另一个弱点：一个协调器正确地承认了仅基于新颖性的拒绝，随后却将其总结为经测量的关闭。此外，在保留的实验中，基于前缀的接受门控在三个阈值下均产生了比无门控适应更差的目标分数。这些案例催生了一种可检查的交接机制，将所测试的命题、其适用范围、候选者与评估者身份、检查状态以及重新开放条件关联起来。一个调度树则区分了调查、修复、重新开放和停止等操作。
tldr: 论文通过分析自主编码智能体中证据被错误复用的典型案例，提出了一种将测试命题、适用范围、评估者身份、检查状态和重新开放条件关联起来的可检查交接机制，以规范从实验到决策的证据复用流程。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes representative cases of evidence misuse in autonomous coding agents and proposes an inspectable handoff that links the tested proposition, its scope, evaluator identity, check statuses, and reopening conditions to govern evidence reuse from experiments to decisions.
